title: Wandering will not quench this fire
summary: Doubt is quenched inwardly, not by more wandering. Let the Guru's teaching extinguish the inner fire.
takeaway: Let the Guru's teaching extinguish the inner fire.
lifeApplication: Sit still with the Guru's words in the mind before searching again; let ego and desire lose air there.

source.shortMeaning: Doubt is quenched inwardly, not by more wandering.
source.lifeApplication: Sit still with one clear line before you go searching again.
